script:
N_S=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/events/count" --field .)
LEAF_S=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S" --field leaf_event_id)
WD_S=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S" --field workspace.working_dir)
test "$LEAF_S" = "$E2"
FW=$(control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/fork" --expect 201 \
  --check execution_status eq idle --check forked_from_conversation_id eq "$S" \
  --check . contains '"forked_from_event_id": null' --check leaf_event_id eq "$E2" \
  --check workspace.working_dir eq "$WD_S" --check . contains '"title": null' \
  --save F10.fork-whole/fork --field id)
test "$FW" != "$S"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$FW" --quiet --check forked_from_conversation_id eq "$S" --check execution_status eq idle
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$FW/events/count" --check . eq "$N_S" --save F10.fork-whole/count
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$FW/events/$E2" --expect 200 --check id eq "$E2" --check parent_id eq "$E1"
test "$(control-agent-server state ls 'events/event-*.json' --conversation "$FW" | python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["count"])')" = "$N_S"
control-agent-server state cat meta.json --conversation "$FW" --check forked_from_conversation_id eq "${S//-/}"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S" --quiet --check . contains '"forked_from_conversation_id": null' --check leaf_event_id eq "$E2"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$S/events/count" --check . eq "$N_S"
